page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

p.i: siduum[?] praefectis cohortium non ante solvantur, quàm manibus suis testati fuerint inferiora militiae munera in cohorte gerentes, militibus esse satisfactum; ac ut rationes acceptorum & expensorum quadrimestres non concludantur, nisi coram utroque collegio & deputatorum, & λογιςῶν[?]: curent similiter, ut equites pariter peditesque tum justo numero in alis & cohortibus suis sint, tum armis pro ordinum ratione probè instructi: ut armamentario ne quid desit, quod ad apparatum pertineat; ut ex eo nec ipsi, nec alii, qui Remp. gerunt, quaestum ullum faciant, aut negotiationi hujusmodi quoquo modo se misceant: conveniant quotidiè exceptis diebus Dominicis & festis celebrioribus, aut iis qui supplicationibus publicis sunt destinati, idque bis, semel ante meridiem, iterum post meridiem, sintque in actione per horas plus minus binas, prout negotia poscent. page.notes: The first word of the page, "siduum", is uncertain: the initial letter is an f-like long s, read here as s. The Greek "λογιςῶν" is doubtful and read from a small, rubbed impression. The page number "192" is partly obscured by a decorative mark. The lower left of the page is stained and damaged, but no text is lost there. The body text is set in italic type.
